plainText:
Shu's father (Japanese: シュウの父 Shū's father) is a character from Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!.

==History==
Shu's father left home five years ago to try to capture , but the adventure proved frivolous. He did not catch Mew, but he did capture . 

Shu's father is an accomplished inventor and is the creator of the Income device.

He wanted to name Shu , but his wife decided against it.

Shu once claimed his father used him as bait for catching his Pokémon, made him pass an intelligence test at the same time as a and made him eat Pokémon food.

==Pokémon==
